name: rea-enhancement
description: Toolkits for realestate.com.au. Rental Toolkit: an available-from filter, every results page in one list, a shortlist across searches, inspection planning and exports. Runs entirely in your browser.

scripts.e2e: node test/e2e/smoke.js && node test/e2e/edge.js && node test/e2e/a11y.js
scripts.coverage: node --test --experimental-test-coverage --test-coverage-include=rea-enhancement.user.js test/*.test.js && COVERAGE=1 node test/e2e/smoke.js && COVERAGE=1 COVERAGE_APPEND=1 node test/e2e/edge.js
scripts.ci: npm run check && npm run e2e
scripts.e2e:setup: npm install --no-save --no-audit --no-fund playwright@1.56.1 axe-core@4.13.0 && npx playwright install chromium
